title: Zesty Middle Eastern Myeolchi Anchovies Hummus
description: A sweet and creamy Middle Eastern dish featuring myeolchi anchovies, this hummus is a comforting and lacto-vegetarian-friendly option. It is slow-cooked to perfection to bring out the flavors.
instructions: Rinse the myeolchi anchovies and soak them in water for 30 minutes to rehydrate.
Drain and chop the rehydrated myeolchi anchovies into small pieces.
In a blender or food processor, combine the chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and olive oil.
Add the chopped myeolchi anchovies, salt, and paprika to the blender and process until smooth.
With the blender running, slowly add the water and continue processing until the desired consistency is reached.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer the hummus to a serving bowl and garnish with paprika and parsley.
Serve the hummus with pita bread or vegetables and enjoy.
